documented_probe: C-f3890ab9 (bin point clouds into normalized 2d histograms): this task directly covers the competency on the required second independent scenario; the verifier fully checks the capability (normalization, shape, bounds) on hidden cases.
notes: Single-stage: parse a radar-fix stream plus a grid spec, filter fixes to a bounding box, bin with the floor/upper-edge rule, and normalize counts to sum to one. Hidden cases probe boundary points (interior edges, corners, xmax/ymax closure), just-outside fixes, scientific notation, malformed/blank lines, 1x1 grids, empty inputs, and fractional normalization. Rubric is nonzero for reasoning_depth (edge-inclusive binning rule), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (four hidden cases), and quantitative_correctness (exact floats summing to one). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure; totals bucket to medium.
